plans.title: Clock entries on one date, all employees
plans.sql:
select id, profile_id, clock_in, clock_out, clock_status, break_minutes, total_hours, is_overtime
  from public.time_clock_entries
 where clock_in >= '2026-07-31T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz - interval '1 day'
   and clock_in <  '2026-07-31T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz + interval '2 days'
 order by clock_in
